Chapter 1082: Chapter 19 Advancement in Strength (Please Subscribe)

The Chaos Tree, as a peak twelfth-layer supreme treasure, is a Great Saint-tier artifact.

As soon as it took root in Lin Yuan’s inner universe, it produced immediate and stunning effects.

“My inner universe?”

Lin Yuan’s expression instantly turned to one of astonishment, and he immediately focused on sensing every subtle transformation within his inner universe.

The Chaos Tree’s impact on his inner universe was multifaceted: spatial-temporal stability further enhanced, the rules operating with increasing perfection, and so forth.

These changes were within Lin Yuan’s expectations.

Moreover, once the Chaos Tree took root, faint traces of Chaos Qi began to permeate his inner universe, akin to the strands of Chaos Qi scattered across the Chaos Void.

These strands of Chaos Qi caused Lin Yuan’s inner universe to undergo a deeper level of metamorphosis.

Rustle.

The boundaries of Lin Yuan’s inner universe began frantically expanding.

Previously, Lin Yuan’s inner universe, after mastering “Infinite Void,” had reached a radius of twenty million light-years.

This was close to the maximum limit of Lin Yuan’s inner universe. Any substantial increase beyond this point would have required him to ascend to the Dominator realm and elevate his life essence.

But now.

The originally twenty-million-light-year-radius inner universe suddenly surged upward.

Twenty-one million.

Twenty-three million.

Twenty-five million.

…

In less than a moment, it reached a radius of thirty million light-years.

Thirty-one million.

Thirty-two million.

…

By the time it approached a radius of thirty-three million light-years, the inner universe’s expansion finally began to slow.

Although it continued to expand, the rate noticeably decreased; it was estimated to surpass thirty-three-million-light-years slightly.

“As expected of the Chaos Tree.”

Lin Yuan’s expression revealed awe as he marveled at the Chaos Tree’s contribution to his inner universe—a nearly doubled radius in size.

It should be noted that for an inner universe of Lin Yuan’s current magnitude, achieving such growth required either the gradual grinding of time—ten Cosmic Eras, a hundred Cosmic Eras—with slow expansion leading to qualitative changes.

Or, it would necessitate a great leap in realm, where an enhancement in life essence would bring about significant improvements in all aspects of his being.

“Tuolong Great Saint truly put effort into cultivating successors.”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

Tuolong Great Saint was none other than the true body of the Great Saint Soul Fragment residing within Cang Yulong.

While observing the fragments of the Great Saint’s cultivation memories, Lin Yuan had identified this ancient Great Saint.

Each Great Saint’s chosen path was highly distinctive, and their renown often spread across multiple Void Domains. Unless their era had vanished into obscurity, their names would inevitably be remembered.

Tuolong Great Saint was a Chaos Great Saint adept in the physical body domain.

In terms of battle prowess, even if not comparable to peerless Great Saints, he was still far stronger than newcomer Great Saints like the Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

“What a shame…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. That Chaos Tree had ultimately fallen into his hands.

In truth, it wasn’t exactly a matter of regret: had Lin Yuan not intervened, Cang Yulong would one day cave under Nine Profound Venerable’s torment, surrendering everything. By then, not only would the Chaos Tree and inheritance space be lost, but even Cang Yulong himself would not survive.

In fact, if not for the Chaos Tree, Lin Yuan wouldn’t have risked becoming enemies with a Venerable.

“With my current strength, there’s no need to resort to the Divine Skill ‘Tear Heaven’ when sparring with Nine Profound Venerable.”

Lin Yuan mused inwardly.

The Divine Skill ‘World’ alone would be enough to force Nine Profound Venerable to reveal his life-preserving artifact. The inner universe’s enhancement benefited the Divine Skill ‘World’ most notably.

This physical body Divine Ability was entirely reliant on the strength of Lin Yuan’s inner universe.

Of course, this was under sparring circumstances. In a life-or-death struggle, there would be no holding back; all hidden trump cards and ultimate moves would surely be unleashed.

…

Just as Lin Yuan’s inner universe continued expanding and the flowing ripple of rules grew increasingly stable.

Deep within his inner universe, a jade gourd trembled faintly, and a red-robed young girl with twin ponytails emerged.

“Why is this inner universe…”

The red-robed girl carefully observed the entire inner universe. As the Spirit of Jade Gourd and a Protector of the thirteenth-layer inheritance “Infinite Void,” she naturally paid close attention to Lin Yuan’s inner universe.

After all, the core foundation of the “Infinite Void” inheritance lay within the inner universe itself.

“Is it the Chaos Tree?”

The red-robed girl immediately identified the source of these changes.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan condensed his figure and appeared beside her.

As the creator of the inner universe, Lin Yuan was keenly aware of its countless subtle transformations, so naturally he noticed the jade gourd’s activity.

“Senior, you also know about the Chaos Tree?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

“I certainly know of the Chaos Tree.”

The red-robed girl glanced at Lin Yuan and said, “Such supreme treasures often fall from the Primordial Lands of the Chaos Void, exceedingly rare and especially unparalleled in enhancing inner universes.”

“For cultivators of the ‘Infinite Void’ inheritance lineage, the Chaos Tree produces truly incredible effects…”

The red-robed girl explained.

“Falling from the Primordial Lands of the Chaos Void?”

Lin Yuan gazed at the red-robed girl.

The Chaos Tree originated from the Primordial Lands?

When Lin Yuan had broken through the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth layers, he had endured the infusion of the Primordial Lands within the Chaos Void, and he felt the vast, boundless aura it contained.

The Chaos Tree came from there?

“Outside the Primordial Lands, true Chaos Trees cannot be nurtured.” The red-robed girl shook her head and continued, “I know you might have heard claims that the World Tree could evolve into a Chaos Tree, but that’s virtually impossible.”

“I see.”

Lin Yuan glanced toward another direction within his inner universe.

There, another massive tree swayed gently—it was the World Tree.

Ever since Lin Yuan had mastered the first level of “Infinite Void,” his inner universe expanded to a radius of twenty million light-years, significantly diminishing the utility of the World Tree.
